declarationsAdded.why: ADDED 15 October 2026 (C55), under his M6 exception. His words, reply filed 16 October 2026, item 9 point 9: "Build-out origin needs no further value: Approved under the narrow authority ruling." - approving change 9 of our 15 October email ("The origin of a build-out needs no further value", our wording). His reply filed 17 October 2026, M6: "I approve the narrow authority exception where the added statement provably cannot contradict existing knowledge. However, the machine-readable representation must preserve the distinction between: No further value is required. The value is explicitly unrestricted. A necessary value is missing." And his 16 October item 8: "A context may explicitly establish that a particular scoring-condition detail requires no additional value." RPC-001-18.a establishes the origin condition (type=origin). RPC-001 already declares V6 (CLAIMED type IN {progression, control, exclusion}; NOT_AUTHORED type=control; NOT_AUTHORED type=exclusion), none of which reaches the origin, so its value line was a declared gap under GF2's general gap. This declaration says explicitly - qualifier NO_FURTHER_VALUE, the first of his three states - that the origin's value needs nothing more. It joins a row RPC-001 already declares only through the M6 exception (onDeclaredRow PROVEN_DISJOINT, corpus-restatement.ts provenDisjointRefusal): a qualified non-claim, no deferral, proved disjoint from every declaration RPC-001 has on V6, every CLAIMED any contract has on V6, and every value-authoring item on V6. Scope WHOLE_GAME like its sibling V6 declarations: the condition's episode scope is its item's (C52); the declaration says only what the field needs. Canonical RPC-001 knowledge on his ruling, not a provisional choice. Measured the day it landed: the only line that moves anywhere is RPC-001-18.a::V6 (declared gap -> not constrained, NO_FURTHER_VALUE, in every composition holding RPC-001; 'excluded' in the full corpus, through the Neutral Player Condition's own exclusion). One Gate A check verdict moves with it, and only where that line was the last one it failed on once C57 typed the two referents: GA-NO-FAILED-LINE FAIL -> PASS in GF2 + RPC-001 and in RPC-001 alone (corrected at the K1 review, 15 October 2026: this sentence first said no check verdict moves, which held only without C57). Gate A stays FAIL everywhere (GA-EPISODE-REACHABLE). contracts.json is untouched.
